Our P. natalensis contigs on the P. cubensis genome

Every ONT natalensis de-novo contig painted at its minimap2 position on the fully-assembled P. cubensis reference (GCF_017499595.1, 13 chromosomes). Recolour by taxonomy (Kraken2), % identity, strand or alignment coverage; raise min coverage to strip spurious partial hits. Click a chromosome for its contig table.

1122 natalensis contigs map to the cubensis chromosomes. The genuine genome is Psilocybe — 964 contigs, 54.12 Mb. 97 non-Psilocybe contigs (mostly Bacteria) also show partial alignments, but at low coverage (median 4.5% of the contig) — spurious hits on short conserved regions, not real placements. Raise min coverage (or tick “Non-Psilocybe only”) to see this directly.
